entries.title: Optimus 0.5.2
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with /plugins update optimus , or Plugins → Optimus → Update in Mercury Desktop. Works with Mercury 1.3.9 and newer; screenshot sizing per model needs Mercury 1.5.2. Screenshots sized for the model in use. Optimus resizes each capture to what the model reads best: Claude and OpenAI 1024×640, Gemini 768×480, open vision models 896×560. Click coordinates stay exact. No screenshot for models that can't see images. Optimus says which window is in front instead of sending a picture the model can't read.

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.2
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.2 Watch your bots work live, approve things one at a time, and get complex jobs done properly. Chats run at the same time, memory keeps one copy of each thing, and text Mercury reads can't steer it. Getting real work done Complex chat work follows Mercury Code's rules. Once the chat makes a plan: it acts instead of announcing; it checks what it made before calling it done; when a tool fails, it fixes the cause or asks, never quietly switching methods. Commands run on Mercury's own Node. Node tools like HyperFrames no longer fail on an older system Node. A video that never rendered isn't sent as finished. A video that's all black, or never moves, is caught before it goes out. Plans keep up. A forgotten last tick is completed. Unfinished plans show "paused" or "stopped" instead of a step stuck "in progress". Skills and services you name are the ones used, for the whole

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.1
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.1 Reading aloud and voice typing now use the voice you chose, Gemini included, and the Optimus update button tells you what it did. Speech Your voice choice counts everywhere. Reading a reply aloud, voice typing and voice notes from Telegram or WhatsApp use the voice service chosen in Settings → Voice when it has a key. A fresh install with only a Gemini key no longer asks for an OpenAI key. Gemini speaks and listens. Gemini reads replies aloud (about 4 seconds for a sentence) and transcribes what you say, with the same key Optimus uses. A Gemini model that's busy or retired falls through to the next one. The "needs a speech service" notice points to Voice settings and names every option (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs) instead of an "Add OpenAI key" button. Mercury Desktop "Update Optimus" says what happened on the microphone & permissions card: updated, n

entries.title: Mercury v1.5.0
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.5.0: Mercury Desktop Mercury now has a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It runs Mercury on your computer or connects to Mercury on a server, keeps itself and your servers up to date, and asks you before anyone new gets in. Mercury Desktop (new) One app for chat, code, bots and research. It installs and starts Mercury on this computer for you, or connects to any number of Mercury servers and switches between them from the top bar. Download it at mercuryagent.sh/download . This first release isn't code-signed yet: macOS asks you to allow it once (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway), Windows SmartScreen once (More info → Run anyway). On a Mac, curl -fsSL https://mercuryagent.sh/install-desktop.sh | sh installs it with no prompt. entries.title: Optimus 0.5.1 (plugin update)
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with /plugins update optimus , or Plugins → Optimus → Update in Mercury Desktop. Mercury itself is unchanged; works with Mercury 1.3.9 and newer. Microphone & permissions on every OS. Mercury Desktop's Optimus page shows the microphone, Accessibility and Screen Recording state at the top, with a microphone picker, a live voice-level test and an off switch. Checks the microphone before a voice session , so a blocked microphone says so instead of a silent session. The macOS permissions check now includes the microphone. Desktop voice controls from 0.5.0: start from Mercury, live transcript, voice levels.

entries.title: WhatsApp 0.1.2 (plugin update)
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with mercury plugins update whatsapp (or /plugins update whatsapp ). Mercury itself is unchanged. Messages from the owner and members arrive again when WhatsApp addresses them by LID ( #247 ). WhatsApp increasingly sends a private id ( …@lid ) instead of the phone number. 0.1.1 couldn't match that id to the owner's number, so those messages were silently ignored while outbound messages still worked. 0.1.2 finds the number behind a LID: from WhatsApp's own LID↔number mapping, plus one lookup when it isn't known yet. It also learns the owner's and members' LIDs as soon as it connects. Incoming calls from the owner are recognised when WhatsApp sends a LID. Business numbers on Meta's hosted service ( @hosted ) count as numbers. No lookup floods. An unknown sender is looked up at most once every 10 minutes, so a stranger messaging repeatedly can't trigger

entries.title: Optimus 0.4.9 (plugin update)
entries.note: Plugin-only update. Install or update with /plugins update optimus . Mercury itself is unchanged. Installs on Mercury builds older than 1.4.0. 0.4.8 failed with Invalid mercury-plugin.json: settings.fields.hotkey: Unrecognized key(s) in object: 'examples' on those builds. The suggested values (talk key, mute key, silence timeout, session length) now live in each setting's description, and the manifest validates on old and current Mercury alike. No change to the companion or behaviour otherwise.

entries.title: 1.4.2 — search that finds things, and a research prompt that asks only when you mean it
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.4.2 Web search finds things again, with no key and with any model, and the research prompt now asks only when you actually want a research article. Web search Three sources that answer. web_search asks Parallel's public search first (keyless, built for agents, about a second, with excerpts and dates), then DuckDuckGo's html page, then its lite page. Bing's web feed, which had started returning unrelated pages, and the engines that refuse automated requests are gone. DuckDuckGo read exactly. Both pages are parsed from their real markup: the title, the real address behind DuckDuckGo's redirect, and the snippet. Ads are dropped, a bot challenge is retried once, and a page Mercury can't read is reported instead of looking empty. News links open the article. News comes from Parallel's article links, then Bing News with its redirects unwrapped to the publisher, then Google N

entries.title: 1.4.1 — Mercury learns how you work, saves its own skills, and searches again
entries.note: ☿ Mercury Agent v1.4.1 Mercury now learns how you like to work, saves the procedures it repeats as its own skills, and its free web search returns real results again. The terminal got a round of fixes too: pickers that work in the attached terminal, a status row that stays useful, and no more "Thinking" forever after /new . Mercury learns how to work with you (ADR-026) Memory became beliefs with evidence. Each thing Mercury believes about you has support, a confidence that fades unless it is seen again, and a status: candidate, held, confirmed by you, contested, retired or forgotten. It learns working traits : reply length, when to ask before acting, options or a recommendation, tone, your expertise per domain. Never health, religion, politics or credentials. You hear about it. Behaviour-changing learning ends a reply with one line, ☿ Noted: … , and "forget that" undoes it. /memory learn
